Sonic Starquakes ~ Suspended between structure and movement, silhouettes drift like invisible energy fields. Glass organza, air-chiffon and translucent carbon fibre dissolve the body’s outline, while electromagnetic embroideries echo the resonant waves of starquakes. Inspired by the formation of stars, from plasma to nebula, light becomes an active material, continually transforming the garments in motion. Rahul Mishra’s Fall 2026 Haute Couture collection, “Devi: The Eternal Muse,” was a breathtaking tribute to the timeless power of femininity, drawing inspiration from Indian temple sculpture and the philosophy that beauty is revealed rather than created. Through exquisitely hand-embroidered gowns, sculptural corsets, fluid drapery, and silhouettes that appeared carved from stone, Mishra transformed couture into wearable art, celebrating the craftsmanship of over a thousand Indian artisans. Rich in symbolic detail, the collection balanced monumental structure with ethereal movement, while muted stone hues gave way to luminous metallics and jewel tones, evoking divine figures coming to life. The result was a deeply spiritual and visually arresting presentation that reaffirmed Mishra’s mastery of storytelling, craftsmanship, and the fusion of India’s artistic heritage with contemporary haute couture.  #fashion #runway #couture #rahulmishra #desi
